tools.name: mac_screenshot
tools.description: Capture the Mac screen as PNG base64, optionally cropped to region {x,y,w,h}. Returns {scale, logical_size, screen:'main'} for the main display; click coordinates are in points (pixels / scale).

tools.name: mac_ax_state
tools.description: Read the foreground app's accessibility tree (element index/role/title/value/frame; indexes feed mac_click/mac_drag for 30s); menu bar pruned by default (use mac_menu_command); optional app name and depth (default 3, clamped 1-10). Returns ax_empty if the app has no AX-visible window (not frontmost / another Space).

tools.name: mac_click
tools.description: Click at {x,y} or on a UI element, with optional button (left|right|middle) and count. Use element_index from the latest mac_ax_state (valid 30s); returns element_no_longer_valid when stale.

tools.name: mac_drag
tools.description: Drag from one UI element to another (move windows, sliders, selections). Use from_index/to_index from the latest mac_ax_state (valid 30s); returns element_no_longer_valid when stale.

tools.name: mac_scroll
tools.description: Scroll the frontmost window up/down/left/right by a number of pages (default 1); moves the pointer over that window first.

tools.name: mac_key
tools.description: Press a key or modifier chord, e.g. 'return', 'esc', 'cmd-c', 'cmd-shift-v', 'arrow-up'. Pass app to refuse input unless that app is frontmost (focus guard).

tools.name: mac_type
tools.description: Type text at the current focus without modifier keys. Pass app to refuse input unless that app is frontmost (focus guard). Not IME-safe: with a CJK input method active, keystrokes may be re-segmented — use mac_paste for reliable text entry.

tools.name: mac_paste
tools.description: Write text to the clipboard and paste it with Cmd+V. Pass app to refuse input unless that app is frontmost (focus guard).

tools.name: mac_menu_command
tools.description: Run an app's menu bar command via accessibility traversal (locale-safe).

tools.name: browser_launch
tools.description: Launch the browser with a persistent profile (headed by default; pass headless:true for headless).

tools.name: browser_navigate
tools.description: Navigate the current tab to an http(s) URL. file:// is disabled unless NORACU_ALLOW_FILE_URL=1.

tools.name: browser_snapshot
tools.description: Return the page's ARIA accessibility snapshot plus a clickable element index list (indexes feed browser_click).

tools.name: browser_screenshot
tools.description: Screenshot the page with optional fullPage, format png|jpeg, quality (1-100, jpeg) and clip {x,y,width,height}; returns the image plus DPR/viewport metadata.

tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Click a page element, preferring element_index; selector is a fallback, xy pixel coordinates not recommended. Use element_index from the latest browser_snapshot (valid 30s); returns element_no_longer_valid when stale.

tools.name: browser_fill
tools.description: Fill an input field matched by selector; fill replaces the whole value (browser_type appends keystrokes).

tools.name: browser_press_key
tools.description: Press a key or chord, e.g. 'Enter' or 'Control+A'.

tools.name: browser_type
tools.description: Type text via the keyboard into the focused element; type appends keystrokes (browser_fill replaces the whole value).

tools.name: browser_scroll
tools.description: Scroll the page up or down by a number of pages.

tools.name: browser_read
tools.description: Read the page's visible text, optionally scoped to a selector.

tools.name: browser_evaluate
tools.description: Evaluate JavaScript in the page and return the result.

tools.name: browser_close
tools.description: Close the browser.

tools.name: phone_status
tools.description: EXPERIMENTAL. Needs iPhone Mirroring and a python3 with pyobjc. Return the iPhone Mirroring session status as JSON (running, window, onscreen, frontmost, live, overlay, paused).

tools.name: phone_launch
tools.description: EXPERIMENTAL. Needs iPhone Mirroring and a python3 with pyobjc. Ensure iPhone Mirroring is running, brought to the front, and clicks Resume when the connection is paused.

tools.name: phone_screenshot
tools.description: EXPERIMENTAL. Needs iPhone Mirroring and a python3 with pyobjc. Screenshot the iPhone screen (the Mirroring window, captured by window id so it works even when covered). Fails with capture_failed instead of returning another window's pixels.

tools.name: phone_ocr
tools.description: EXPERIMENTAL. Needs iPhone Mirroring and a python3 with pyobjc. OCR the iPhone screen into text with coordinates. Fails with capture_failed instead of returning another window's pixels.

tools.name: phone_find
tools.description: EXPERIMENTAL. Needs iPhone Mirroring and a python3 with pyobjc. Locate text on the iPhone screen. Fails with capture_failed instead of returning another window's pixels.

tools.name: phone_tap
tools.description: EXPERIMENTAL. Needs iPhone Mirroring and a python3 with pyobjc. Tap at {x, y} in normalized 0-1 coordinates. Refused with mirror_not_live when the mirror is paused. Optional expect: text that must be on screen (OCR) first, else nothing is sent.

tools.name: phone_longpress
tools.description: EXPERIMENTAL. Needs iPhone Mirroring and a python3 with pyobjc. Long-press at {x, y} for an optional duration in seconds. Optional expect: text that must be on screen (OCR) first, else nothing is sent.

tools.name: phone_swipe
tools.description: EXPERIMENTAL. Needs iPhone Mirroring and a python3 with pyobjc. Swipe (mouse drag) from [x,y] to [x,y] over an optional duration in ms, for gestures such as Home Screen paging; to move a list use phone_scroll. Optional expect: text that must be on screen (OCR) first, else nothing is sent.

tools.name: phone_home
tools.description: EXPERIMENTAL. Go to the iPhone Home Screen via the iPhone Mirroring menu (works without python/pyobjc when the mirror is connected); falls back to an imctl swipe.

tools.name: phone_app_switcher
tools.description: EXPERIMENTAL. Open the iPhone App Switcher via the iPhone Mirroring menu (works without python/pyobjc when the mirror is connected); falls back to an imctl gesture.

tools.name: phone_scroll
tools.description: EXPERIMENTAL. Needs iPhone Mirroring and a python3 with pyobjc. Scroll up or down by `distance` window heights (0 < distance <= 3, default 0.5) using trackpad-style scroll events. Reports scroll_no_effect when the screen did not change (list end, or the view does not scroll). Optional expect: text that must be on screen (OCR) first, else nothing is sent.

tools.name: phone_type
tools.description: EXPERIMENTAL. Needs iPhone Mirroring and a python3 with pyobjc. Type text via the clipboard (IME-safe). Restores the clipboard only after OCR sees the text, else reports type_not_confirmed and keeps the text. replace=true selects all and overwrites the field. Optional expect: on-screen text (OCR), else nothing is sent.

tools.name: phone_key
tools.description: EXPERIMENTAL. Needs iPhone Mirroring and a python3 with pyobjc. Press a key: return, delete, up, down, left, or right. Optional expect: text that must be on screen (OCR) first, else nothing is sent.

tools.name: phone_open
tools.description: EXPERIMENTAL. Needs iPhone Mirroring and a python3 with pyobjc. Open an app: Home Screen, Spotlight via the menu, clear, type the name, OCR-pick the exact row and tap it; confirms the app opened (frame diff + OCR), taps the Top Hit icon when the label tap does nothing, else open_not_confirmed, back on the Home Screen.
